_note: Enemy shot looks beyond their element (src/vfx/shot_looks.gd). monsters: monster id (Krypta def id, or the Frostgruft theme mob kind) -> look; attacks: only shots of these attack ids (empty or absent: every shot); tint frost: the Frostgruft's rimed arrow. looks.arrow: the bone arrow on the 3 px art grid, lengths in grid cells along its flight (shaft_len bone shaft, head_len iron head, fletch_len vanes), colours lit to shade (hex); frost_shaft_tint [colour, share] tints the bone. impact: splinters thrown back off the head, their speed and up (world px/s), dust motes, rime cells and ice_chips of the rimed arrow, sfx_wall / sfx_hit (audio_sfx.json events, played only where the world sounds no impact of its own: the Frostgruft).
